## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 30 avr. 2026 - 10 juin 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _ADWired_, 10 juin 2026, 2/5: "I tried this app for a day during the trial period and liked it enough to purchase a one-year subscription. Unfortunately, shortly after subscribing, the app became unstable. It frequently logs me out, the widgets have never worked (they appear blank), and Apple Health syncing stopped working after the first day. I contacted support and initially received a quick response with some follow-up questions, but after providing the requested information, I never received a solution or any further assistance. I tried reinstalling the app multiple times, but the issues persisted. Out of frustration, I canceled my subscription and requested a refund. My refund request was denied. As a result, I paid for a subscription to an app that does not function properly, received no resolution for the problems I reported, and was then denied a refund. This has been a very disappointing customer experience."
<!--/ir-theme-->

            2. _HectorZeroni03_, 29 avr. 2026, 2/5: "App crashes spontaneously 20APR2025 edit: Communication to the support staff is good as they respond about once a day.
